statement: Whenever sum_imbalance_numbers(nums) returns a result r, r = sum over l from 0 to N-1 of sum over u from l to N-1 of I(nums[l..u]), where for a non-empty array arr of length m, I(arr) = #{ i | 0 <= i < m-1 and s[i+1] - s[i] > 1 }, and s is the nondecreasing sorted copy of arr. Here nums[l..u] is the contiguous subarray from index l through index u inclusive.
preconditions: Let N = len(nums). N is an integer with 1 <= N <= 1000, and for every i with 0 <= i < N, 1 <= nums[i] <= N.

statement: For every nums satisfying the preconditions, sum_imbalance_numbers(nums) returns a result r; it does not fail with arithmetic overflow, out-of-bounds access, or panic.
preconditions: Let N = len(nums). N is an integer with 1 <= N <= 1000, and for every i with 0 <= i < N, 1 <= nums[i] <= N.

statement: Whenever sum_imbalance_numbers(nums) returns r, 0 <= r <= N*(N-1)*(N+1)/6.
preconditions: Let N = len(nums). N is an integer with 1 <= N <= 1000, and for every i with 0 <= i < N, 1 <= nums[i] <= N.

statement: Whenever sum_imbalance_numbers(nums) returns r, r = 0 if and only if for every i with 0 <= i < N-1, |nums[i+1] - nums[i]| <= 1.
preconditions: Let N = len(nums). N is an integer with 1 <= N <= 1000, and for every i with 0 <= i < N, 1 <= nums[i] <= N.

statement: Whenever sum_imbalance_numbers(nums) returns r, r >= #{ i | 0 <= i < N-1 and |nums[i+1] - nums[i]| > 1 }.
preconditions: Let N = len(nums). N is an integer with 1 <= N <= 1000, and for every i with 0 <= i < N, 1 <= nums[i] <= N.

statement: Let rev be the slice of length N with rev[i] = nums[N-1-i] for 0 <= i < N. Whenever sum_imbalance_numbers(nums) returns r and sum_imbalance_numbers(rev) returns r_rev, r = r_rev.
preconditions: Let N = len(nums). N is an integer with 1 <= N <= 1000, and for every i with 0 <= i < N, 1 <= nums[i] <= N.

statement: Define shifted[i] = nums[i] + c for 0 <= i < N. Whenever sum_imbalance_numbers(nums) returns r and sum_imbalance_numbers(shifted) returns r_shifted, r = r_shifted.
preconditions: Let N = len(nums). N is an integer with 1 <= N <= 1000, and for every i with 0 <= i < N, 1 <= nums[i] <= N. Let c be an integer such that for every i with 0 <= i < N, 1 <= nums[i] + c <= N.

statement: Define refl[i] = C - nums[i] for 0 <= i < N. Whenever sum_imbalance_numbers(nums) returns r and sum_imbalance_numbers(refl) returns r_refl, r = r_refl.
preconditions: Let N = len(nums). N is an integer with 1 <= N <= 1000, and for every i with 0 <= i < N, 1 <= nums[i] <= N. Let C be an integer such that for every i with 0 <= i < N, 1 <= C - nums[i] <= N.

statement: Whenever sum_imbalance_numbers(nums) returns r and sum_imbalance_numbers(ext) returns r_ext, r_ext >= r.
preconditions: Let N = len(nums). N is an integer with 1 <= N <= 999, and for every i with 0 <= i < N, 1 <= nums[i] <= N. Let x be an integer with 1 <= x <= N+1. Define ext of length N+1 by ext[i] = nums[i] for 0 <= i < N and ext[N] = x.

statement: Whenever sum_imbalance_numbers(nums) returns r: if |a-b| <= 1 then r = 0; if |a-b| > 1 then r = #{ (l,u) | 0 <= l <= u < N, there exists i with l <= i <= u and nums[i] = a, and there exists j with l <= j <= u and nums[j] = b }.
preconditions: Let N = len(nums). N is an integer with 1 <= N <= 1000, and for every i with 0 <= i < N, 1 <= nums[i] <= N. Let a and b be integers such that for every i with 0 <= i < N, nums[i] = a or nums[i] = b.
Let N = len(nums). N is an integer with 1 <= N <= 1000, and for every i with 0 <= i < N, 1 <= nums[i] <= N. Let D be the number of distinct values occurring among nums[0],...,nums[N-1].
